deviations_from_container_reference: No Docker runtime in this sandbox; namespace/tmpfs/chroot/rlimit stack used instead (pinned python:3.14-slim container replaced by host CPython 3.13.5 at /usr/bin/python3).

Child runs as mapped-root inside the private user namespace (newuidmap unavailable), so in-namespace root could in principle attempt umount of overlays or a double-chroot escape; the static forbidden-import filter (os/ctypes/subprocess...) blocks accepted candidates from attempting it, the view root exposes no /proc, and host-side canaries make any successful escape detectable. Residual accepted and monitored for this exploratory pilot only.
Process-tree leak check is scoped to the child session id, not container-global PIDs.
mechanism: unshare -r -m -n (private user+mount+network namespace) + fresh size-capped tmpfs over /home/z /root /var/tmp /tmp /dev/shm /run + minimal chroot view root (read-only /usr /lib /lib64 /dev/null binds, candidate body at /candidate, trusted harness at /trusted, no /proc) + env -i + RLIMIT_AS 384MiB / RLIMIT_CPU 8s / RLIMIT_FSIZE 1MiB / RLIMIT_NOFILE 32 + per-probe 5s deadline with killpg + session-scoped process-tree leak check + host-side tamper canaries
